in_sanskrit.name: वरु
in_sanskrit.meaning: to wish, to desire, to long for, to crave
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is desired or longed for, the one who is wished for or craved.

in_hindi.name: Varu
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of fertility
in_hindi.long_meaning: Varu एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Varu is the name of a goddess who is the personification of fertility, prosperity, and joy. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.

in_tamil.name: Varu
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Goddess of fertility
in_tamil.long_meaning: Varu ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। In Hindu mythology, Varu is the name of a goddess who is the personification of fertility, prosperity, and joy. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.

in_telugu.name: Varu
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Goddess of fertility
in_telugu.long_meaning: Varu ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। In Hindu mythology, Varu is the name of a goddess who is the personification of fertility, prosperity, and joy. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.

in_marathi.name: Varu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of fertility
in_marathi.long_meaning: Varu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Varu is the name of a goddess who is the personification of fertility, prosperity, and joy. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Varu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of fertility
in_bengali.long_meaning: Varu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Varu is the name of a goddess who is the personification of fertility, prosperity, and joy. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
